headline: Comp sales hit a multi-year high, but core margins slip
summary_short: Revenue rose 2.1% y/y to $4,892M on 3.0% comparable-sales growth, the strongest Q1 comp in four years. GAAP net income rose to $63M ($0.23 diluted EPS) from $38M, even as Adjusted EBIT slipped to $80M from $85M on a tariff-driven 30bp gross-margin hit.
summary_long: Total revenue was $4,892M (+2.1% y/y) on growth across all three nameplates; comparable sales rose 3.0%, the strongest Q1 comp in four years, with Bloomingdale's posting its best Q1 in company history. Gross margin fell 30bp, from an estimated tariff impact; ex-tariff it was flat. SG&A rose 2.0% on continued Reimagine-200 and Bloomingdale's investment, partly offset by cost containment. GAAP net income rose to $63M ($0.23 diluted EPS) from $38M, helped by a lower 32.3% effective tax rate and a $17M lease-modification benefit, though Adjusted EBIT slipped to $80M from $85M. Operating cash flow swung to $292M from -$64M on a $328M credit-card litigation settlement; cash rose to $1,294M. The company repurchased $50M of stock and paid a $0.1915/share dividend.
